authority.fresh_read: Read pinned official raw stdlib.html Mathematical Utilities and spec.html Standard functions in this preparation. Browser-rendered line numbers differ from persisted inventory; URL, commit and section anchor are authoritative identifiers.
authority.source_kind: These four are native mathematical functions, not std.jsonnet function bodies. Public signatures plus formal standard-mathematics wording and general calls/demand/finite-number rules supply the finite criteria. Hypot is listed in stdlib Mathematical Utilities but omitted from the formal list; its conventional Euclidean-norm behavior is an explicit mathematical inference, not a quoted formal equation.
authority.interpretation: Mantissa/exponent normalized base-two decomposition is a conventional IEEE interpretation, explicitly distinguished from an exact spelling in the terse formal paragraph. Do not promote these finite witnesses to a whole-function accuracy certificate. Hypot a,b names are explicit public text.
authority.expected_value_basis: Integer Pythagorean triples and exact ordinary dyadic decomposition are independently calculated literals. tan intervals follow alternating sin/cos series on abs(x)<=1 with terms through degree 11/10; rounding slack is deliberately broad. No Go/C++ output supplies an expectation.
authority.excluded: No arbitrary ULP threshold, all-exponent sweep, pole-neighbor accuracy, signed-zero spelling, zero mantissa normalization, error-message/competing-error order, callback count, A0, N0/R0, inherited std receiver or publication/platform claim.
authority.no_a0_dependency: Selected direct builtin paths: builtin_params -> normal call binding -> math_builtin -> number_value and finite. Fixture uses Array constructors only, no Array+Array. String formatting helpers are not executed to obtain numeric oracles.
